_readme: Resume state for the newsletter harvest (tools/upkeep-routine.md step 2).
Read this BEFORE a harvest pass; update `last_processed`/`count`/`updated` and COMMIT it after.
This file lives in the repo (not session memory) precisely so a CLOUD agent can clone, resume, and open a PR.
`react-brain lint` cross-checks each `count` against encyclopedia.yaml sources_digested — they must match.
Narrative harvest history (what each pass changed, process learnings) lives in tools/harvest-log/LEDGER.md — in-repo since 2026-08-07.

this-week-in-react.name: This Week in React
this-week-in-react.notes: issue pages fetch directly at /newsletter/{n} — BUT a 200 IS NOT PROOF OF PUBLICATION: on 2026-08-18 /newsletter/294 returned a 175KB PAGE with the title 'This Week In React #294: ...' , description 'Hi everyone!' and only the upcoming issue's sponsor slots (posthog 'twir-aug19'). `harvest prep` probed it, wrote a manifest and froze a bench fixture off that stub — both were deleted. Cross-check the ARCHIVE listing at /newsletter (it stopped at #293) or reject titles ending in ': ...' before treating an issue as live. #293 (Aug 5) → #294 slated Aug 19, i.e. the author skipped a week

react-digest.name: React Digest
react-digest.notes: issues slug-titled by featured article; article/depth-driven — durable yield is usually one decision-guide reading. Archive moved: /digests 404s, use /newsletters or /newsletters.rss (newest-first, resolves the slug). Slug numbers are NOT sequential (2316 → 2320 → 2325 → 2330 → 2335 → 2340 → 2344)

react-native-rewind.name: React Native Rewind
react-native-rewind.notes: slug-titled; each issue page carries an authoritative 'Issue #NN' label near the title — use THAT, not sequential guesswork, to resume. RSS at /newsletter-rss.xml lists newest-first; canonical host is www.thereactnativerewind.com. #52 (2026-08-10) and #53 (2026-08-17) broke the 0-keep streak (#50/#51 were essay issues): 2 keeps each, incl. the CocoaPods read-only timeline that dates RN 0.87's SwiftPM path. Sponsor slots (Codemagic) can carry real product news — verify against repo/registry, never the ad copy, and disclose the provenance in the manifest

native-weekly.name: Native Weekly
native-weekly.notes: nativeweekly.com is a shell — use the beehiiv archive (slugs like /p/aug-14-2026-issue-18); author also authors rnsec (watch self-promotion); strongest beat = agentic dev tooling. Cadence confirmed irregular: #17 2026-07-17 → #18 2026-08-14 (four passes with nothing new in between). Format is a release roundup + article roundup, so most links land already-held or as duplicates of the firsthand release watch — the articles are where its keeps are

react-weekly.name: React Weekly
react-weekly.notes: site + api.react-weekly.dev are JS-shell/auth-gated — harvest via rss.xml content:encoded (FULL bodies). Links inside are api.react-weekly.dev/track/click/<id> redirects: resolve each with `curl -L` before dispositioning. `harvest inventory`/`coverage` return 0 links on the issue URL, so the coverage gate cannot cover this source — the RSS-derived manifest is the record. RSS window = latest 20: a backlog >20 issues loses them permanently (issues 1-7 already unreachable). TanStack-heavy.
